Frequently Asked Questions

Is Air University better than SZABIST?

Both Air University Islamabad and Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science & Technology are HEC-recognized universities. Air University is public (est. 2002) in Islamabad, while SZABIST is private (est. 1995) in Karachi / Islamabad / Larkana / Hyderabad. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between Air University and SZABIST?

Air University's fee is approximately Rs. 1.2–2.2L/sem per semester, while SZABIST's is Rs. 1.2–2L/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for Air University and SZABIST?

Air University: AU Entry Test + Matric/O-Level + FSc/A-Level weightage. Accepts FSc, A-Levels, equivalents.. SZABIST: Entrance test + interview/group discussion.
